senses.gloss: m. pl. (cubicularia, sub. gausapina &c.) woolly bed-covers, blankets.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 24:13">Targ. Y. I Deut. XXIV, 13</cite> (h. text <cite ref="U01355"><he>שַׂלְמָה</he></cite>).—

<cite ref="Shabbat 51a:10">Sabb. 51ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 3:20">Tosef. ib. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 4:20">IV</cite>), 20, opp. <cite ref="O00185"><he>סדין</he></cite> linen sheets.

<cite ref="Gittin 70b:20">Gitt. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ וסדיני</he> (Var. <cite ref="C00508"><he>גושפקי</he></cite>) shall we ascertain his sanity of mind, according to the season, by asking him whether he desires heavy or light covers? <cite ref="Gittin 35a:17">Ib. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>גלופקרין אחד</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="C00914"><he>גלופקרא</he></cite>) one set of bed-clothes.—
